title: Realize twelve-shear backgrounds in one fixed36 force family
statement: The original12 first-harmonic divergence-free sine/cosine fields have modes +/-e_j. Quadratic cross interactions add only +/-e_j+/-e_l,j<l; same-axis doubled interactions vanish. Choose2 integer transverse polarizations and sine/cosine for each of6 new sign pairs, giving24+12=36 fixed fields. For any rational-polynomial12-shear b, f_b=b_t-nu Delta b+P[(b.grad)b] is in their span. Approximate2pi,4pi^2 by rational p,q with error<=zeta. If C_b>=sup sum|alpha_j|, rationalized force has LinfinityL2 residual<=zeta(nu C_b+C_b^2). This closes fixed-basis algebra and coefficient portability only; it assumes no physical strain-coupled contraction theorem.
